register_lowering_aten_op: register a TorchInductor lowering for an aten operation using the register_lowering decorator
create_pointwise_lowering: create a pointwise lowering function that maps elementwise operations to TorchInductor IR
create_reduction_lowering: create a reduction lowering function for sum, prod, max, min operations over tensor axes
register_fallback_handler: register a fallback handler for unsupported aten operations to fall back to ATen eager execution
register_pointwise_op: register a pointwise operation with automatic ops module mapping and type promotion support
